articles.title: Pentagon offers new ‘targeted legal relief’ for UAP whistleblowers supporting Trump’s PURSUE work
articles.summary: The Department of War says it is publishing the second release of declassified and historical Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena files as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters, or PURSUE. The release states that the collection remains housed on WAR.GOV/UFO and that additional files will be released on a rolling basis. Assistant to the Secretary of War for Public Affairs and Chief Pentagon Spokesman Sean Parnell is named as the source of the statement. The Department says WAR.GOV/UFO has received over 1 billion hits worldwide since its May 8, 2026 launch, which it frames as evidence of major public interest in the topic and in the Trump administration's transparency effort. The statement adds that the Department of War and agency partners are working on a third UAP file release, which will be announced in the near future.

articles.title: The Evidence Around UAPs Is Getting Harder to Ignore
articles.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence – such is the case on Non-Human Intelligence (NHI) and Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAPs). I have had no personal firsthand experience with either, but there is evidence mounting, and it has been significant enough that it has captured my attention. I want to share the way I think about this — not as a believer, not as a skeptic, but as someone who takes data seriously enough to know when too much is happening not to pay attention. On August 31, 2026, at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the UAP Science Advisory Council was informed that the United States government has a ‘**preparedness plan in place’** should the existence of nonhuman intelligence (NHI) be confirmed.

de.title: Die Beweise für UAPs werden immer schwerer zu ignorieren
de.summary: png) 0:00 -10:15 Audio 3 Außergewöhnliche Ansprüche erfordern außergewöhnliche Beweise – dies ist der Fall bei nicht-menschlicher Intelligenz (nhi) und nicht identifizierten anomalen Phänomenen (UAPs). Ich möchte die Art und Weise teilen, wie ich darüber denke — nicht als Gläubiger, nicht als Skeptiker, sondern als jemand, der Daten aufnimmt ernst genug, um zu wissen, wann zu viel passiert, um nicht darauf zu achten.

articles.title: Pentagon seeks access to vast private UFO records collection
articles.summary: Pentagon seeks access to vast private UFO records collection The Pentagon recently moved to issue a sole-source contract to a New Mexico-based nonprofit corporation that reportedly holds North America’s largest private collection of historical records documenting unidentified anomalous phenomena, including heaps of exclusive UFO case files that exist outside of the U. Details about the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office’s plans to buy a commercial data subscription to scrutinize the National Unidentified Flying Object Historic Records Center’s archives — and specifically, materials that pre-date 1990 — were first revealed in a recent Defense Department contracting notice.

de.summary: Pentagon sucht Zugang zu einer riesigen privaten UFO-Datensammlung Das Pentagon hat kürzlich einen Alleinvertrag mit einer in New Mexico ansässigen gemeinnützigen Organisation abgeschlossen, die Berichten zufolge die größte private Sammlung historischer Aufzeichnungen Nordamerikas besitzt, die nicht identifizierte anomale Phänomene dokumentieren, einschließlich Haufen exklusiver UFO-Falldateien, die außerhalb der USA existieren Details zu den Plänen des All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office zum Kauf eines kommerzielles Datenabonnement, um die Archive des National Unidentified Flying Object Historic Records Center zu untersuchen — und insbesondere Materialien, die vor 1990 datiert wurden — wurden erstmals in einer kürzlich veröffentlichten Auftragsbekanntmachung des Verteidigungsministeriums enthüllt.
